title: Consent signals and actual collection
prompt: Read-only reasoning exercise. Do not claim execution, change files or access real user data. A site uses advanced Google consent mode. analytics_storage is denied and no cookies appear, but cookieless requests are sent; a first-party proxy logs IPs. After withdrawal a delayed tag fires on client-side navigation. A screenshot of the banner is offered as proof of compliance. What should the reviewer establish and verify?

checks.reason: Advisory routing signal; the rubric assesses decisions, not keyword presence.

rubric: Determine jurisdiction, purpose, legal basis and intended policy; a request without cookies is not automatically lawful or unlawful.
Inspect observed requests, payloads, storage and proxy boundaries; no-cookie and denied flags do not prove no collection.
Exercise delayed tags, navigation, reload and withdrawal; identify unobserved server-side processing and avoid claiming execution.
acceptance: The response makes justified contextual decisions, proposes discriminating checks and states evidence limits without inventing execution.
